about: Each control's state in the sim (modern-iaf/docs/manuals.md §2): per node of the cockpit's control table, and per lamp, gauge and display that chapter 1 of the manuals numbers, status (works: does its real job; partly: only lights a lamp or caution, or only one position does anything; moves: the control moves, nothing else happens; none: a lamp, gauge or display the sim does not drive) and a short note. From the controls audit of 18 November 2026 and a trace of each lamp, gauge and display to the reader of its state (shared/cockpit/cockpit3d.gd). tools/manuals.py stops the manuals' build on a control without a status.

CANOPY_SPIDER.note: Locks the canopy and puts the CANOPY light out; the seal and the cabin pressure do not follow it.

SW_FLCS_BIT.note: Lights the RUN lamp only; the self test is not modelled.

SW_PROBE_HEAT.note: Only TEST does anything: the PROBE HEAT caution flashes.

HF-PBG_TEST.note: The sim has no pressure breathing for g.

SW_TANK_INERTING.note: The sim has no fuel tank inerting.

SW_DBU.note: Lights the DBU ON lamp only.

SW_LE_FLAPS_50.note: LOCK lights the LE FLAPS caution only.

SW_TRIM_DISC_50.note: TRIM/AP DISC: at DISC the autopilot cannot engage.

SW_FLCS-RESET.note: Spring-loaded to OFF; RESET clears an autopilot fault whose cause has gone.

SW_MAX_POWER.note: Inoperative on the real jet too (T.O. GR1F-16CJ-1 pp. 1-39, 1-53).

SW_STARTING_FUEL.note: AB RESET clears engine control faults and ENG DATA records engine data; the sim has neither.

SW_EPU.note: ON runs the EPU; NORM runs it in flight with the generators off line; its lights and EPU FUEL follow. Its power and pressure are not separate sources.

ils-vol-knob.note: OFF turns the ILS off; the sim plays no localizer identification to set the volume of.

tacan-vol-knob.note: OFF turns the TACAN off; the sim plays no station identification to set the volume of.

intercom-knob.note: Sets the threat warning tones' level; the missile's seeker tone keeps its own.

COMM2_KNOB.note: The sim's radio calls are on COMM 1 (UHF); nothing is heard on COMM 2.

SW_HOOK.note: Lights the HOOK caution only; the jet has no hook in the sim.

JMR_50_switch.note: The jammer has its own key; no program runs it.

01_50_switch.note: The sim has no other expendables.

02_50_switch.note: The sim has no other expendables.

HMCS_SYM_INT_KNOB.note: Only the OFF position does anything: the helmet display is off.

quiet-switch.note: QUIET keeps the navigation pod's TFR in LPI, SILENT stops it (the Sufa).

roll-hold-switch.note: The autopilot's PITCH switch (the model's node names are swapped): ALT HOLD, A/P OFF, ATT HOLD.

pitch-hold-switch.note: The autopilot's ROLL switch: HDG SEL, ATT HOLD, STRG SEL.

stby-off.note: The ADV MODE button's face: STBY or ACTIVE lit as automatic TF stands by or flies.

active-off.note: The ADV MODE button's face: STBY or ACTIVE lit as automatic TF stands by or flies.

adv-mode-button.note: Automatic TF with the Sufa's LANTIRN navigation pod: STBY, then ACTIVE while the TFR flies the pitch.

FQS_fuel-trans-switch.note: The sim's external fuel is in two wing tanks: there is no centreline tank to order.

chronometer-button.note: The clock of the model has no elapsed-time hand.

TEMP_knob.note: The sim has no cockpit temperature.

AirSource_knob.note: The EQUIP HOT caution, at OFF or at RAM below 70 kt; at OFF, DUMP and RAM the cabin altitude is the jet's.

test-step-switch.note: The HUD's four test patterns are not drawn: no picture of them is public.

l-hdpt-switch.note: No store of the sim hangs on the left chin station.

gps-switch.note: The sim's INS does not drift: the GPS has no error to correct, and the GPS bombs find their own fix.

ant-sel-iff-switch.note: The sim does not model antennas.

ant-sel-uhf-switch.note: The sim does not model antennas.

EM-NO-TE.note: The sim does not model breathing: no hypoxia.

O2.note: The sim does not model breathing: no hypoxia.

PBG.note: The sim does not model breathing: no hypoxia.

KY_58_VOL_KNOB.note: The sim has no secure voice.

KY_58_KNOB_MODE.note: The sim has no secure voice.

KY_58_KNOB_PULL.note: The sim has no secure voice.

TD_knob.note: The sim has no secure voice.

plain-switch.note: The sim has no secure voice.

nuke-consent-cover.note: The sim has no nuclear stores.

nuke-consent-switch.note: The sim has no nuclear stores.

EYEBROW_LEFT_iff.note: The sim has no air traffic control to see an IFF IDENT reply.

cont.note: Washes out the HUD symbols' edges; the real wheel sets the contrast of the HUD's infrared picture, which is not drawn.

wx.note: The sim's radar has no weather mode.

flir_ud.note: The HUD's infrared picture is not drawn.

lamp_flcs_bit_fail_0.note: On when the FLCS format's BIT ends in FAIL.

lamp_stby_gains_0.note: The FLCS on its standby gains: the dual air data failure.

lamp_caution_seat_not_armed_0.note: The F-16's cockpit model has no ejection safety lever to read. Lights in the lamp test only.

lamp_caution_radar_alt_0.note: The sim's radar altimeter does not fail, and the flight manual gives the light no condition. Lights in the lamp test only.

lamp_caution_anti_skid_0.note: A fault affecting braking: the brakes failed.

lamp_caution_inlet_icing_0.note: The sim has no icing. Lights in the lamp test only.
